agents/requirements-world-model.txt (`--find-links ./vendor/world-model`).

  base:   experiential-0.7.158+rose.bf75987e-py3-none-any.whl

          to the original 0.7.158 build). The upstream source tree is unavailable, so this
          base wheel is the patch source.
  patches:
          0001-rag-transition-measured-elapsed.patch: RAGTransition carries the real
          measured tool duration (`exp.tool.elapsed_ms` on the result span, never the
          span's ordinal clocks) and each grounded example renders it as
          `elapsed_ms`/`elapsed`. Unmeasured records keep their original bytes and IDs.
  build:  scripts/build-world-model-wheel.sh: unpack the base, apply patches/*.patch,
          set version 0.7.158+rose.bf75987e.elapsed1, then `wheel pack` (wheel==0.45.1)
          with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1791303018; reproducible byte for byte. Only the four
          patched modules and METADATA/RECORD differ from the base wheel.
